answer.submission_route: Appeal verbally through Member Service or in writing with supporting documentation to YOUR region's address above — Highmark's addresses differ by state and region. By phone: The Member Service number on your ID card (verbal appeals accepted) Deadline: 180 days after receipt of the denial (all regions) -- but your denial letter is authoritative. Use the appeal address printed on your denial letter.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: Highmark's policy library looks like it needs JavaScript, but you can search it directly by adding your CPT code to the address: append ?q=27446 (or your code) to the search page URL. If the result is an 'S-' number in the 700s or above, that policy is MCG-based and only viewable in Highmark's licensed Clinical Guideline Tool - request it in writing instead.
answer.notes: no public criteria on file; abstained and routed
